question: In the 2025 Kho Kho World Cup, the Indian men’s team secured the first-ever championship title by defeating which opponent in the final match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian men’s team** etched their names in history by winning the **first-ever Kho Kho World Cup** title in **2025**.
 
• In the final match held on **January 19, 2025**, the Indian men's team defeated **Nepal** with a convincing scoreline of **40-30**, winning by an **innings and 10 points**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Nepal.***
 
• The tournament final was played at the prestigious **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium** located in **New Delhi**, India.
 
• The Indian team remained **unbeaten** throughout the tournament, showcasing tactical dominance and physical agility under the captaincy of **Akshay Bhangre**.
 
• This victory marks a significant milestone for the sport of **Kho Kho**, as it was the **inaugural edition** of the global championship, aimed at promoting this traditional Indian sport on an international platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Double Glory for India**:
 
 
• Apart from the men's team, the **Indian women’s team** also secured the championship title by defeating **Nepal** in their respective final.
 
• The women's team won by an **innings and 13 points** with a final score of **33-20**, completing a historic **double gold** for the host nation.
 
 
 
• **Tournament Scale and Participation**:
 
 
• The **2025 Kho Kho World Cup** featured participation from **24 countries** across **six continents**, including teams from **Brazil**, **South Africa**, **England**, and **Australia**.
 
• The event was organized by the **Kho Kho Federation of India (KKFI)** in association with the **International Kho Kho Federation**.
 
 
 
• **Promotion of Indigenous Sports**:
 
 
• The championship was supported by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India, as part of a broader initiative to include **Kho Kho** in the **2032 Olympic Games**.
 
• The tournament followed the theme of "**Homecoming**," highlighting the sport's ancient roots in India, dating back to the **Mahabharata** era.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Prize Money**: The winners of the tournament were awarded a significant cash prize, with the **KKFI** announcing a total prize pool to encourage athletes from developing nations.
 
• **Historical Context**: **Kho Kho** is one of the oldest forms of outdoor sport in India. The first formal rules were framed in the **1910s**, and the **Kho Kho Federation of India** was established in **1955**.
 
• **Global Reach**: Before the World Cup, the sport gained international visibility through the **Ultimate Kho Kho League**, which introduced modern technology like **Review Systems** and **high-speed cameras** to the game.
 
• **Key Figures**: The event was graced by various dignitaries, including the **Union Sports Minister** and officials from the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**, emphasizing the government's **"Khel Mahakumbh"** and **"Khelo India"** visions.
